messages:
sam: Quick RFC: add a sampled + weighted "variant cost" row to the cost dashboard so PMs can see per-variant unit-econ with cache savings and an uncertainty band before changing routing.

toni: Love it. Two immediate asks: (1) include sample_rate per event so we can inverse-weight, (2) surface a confidence indicator in the UI.

ash: Implementation sketch: hybrid sampling. 100% for billing routes & canaries; adaptive reservoir for others (default 0.5%). At ingest, for sampled events do incremental rollups keyed by (hour, route, model_id, variant, cache_hit, route_policy). Store weighted sums and second moments to compute CI.

sam: Example sampled event (no prompt text):
```json
{
  "ts":1749999999,
  "route":"r_web_ui_chat",
  "tenant":"acct-42",
  "model_id":"rw-2.1",
  "variant":"int8-b",
  "tokens_in":28,
  "tokens_out":210,
  "cache_hit":true,
  "cache_saved_tokens":120,
  "sample_rate":0.005,
  "route_policy":"sticky_v3",
  "is_canary":false
}
```
(we explicitly do NOT send prompt text).

toni: Nice. Aggregator stores: sum_w_tokens_out, sum_w_cache_saved, sum_w, sum_wx2, sample_count. From that we can compute est_sum = sum_wx and var ≈ sum_wx2 - (sum_wx)^2 / sum_w. We'll expose est, ci_low, ci_high, effective_n to console API.

ash: UI: show compact row with sparkline + colored delta % + small CI band. Toggle: "Estimated (sampled)" vs "Exact (100% routes)". Tooltip: "Estimated from sampled telemetry; see export for sampling metadata."

ops-bot: deploybot: telemetry/schema-v3 sampled-rollup pushed to staging at 1750000100. Aggregator prototype live on shard-2.

billing-bot: Heads-up to billing team: please run reconciliation job on staging comparing weighted estimates vs full-capture for a few tenants. We need invoice parity within 1%.

sam: Permissioning: add econ.variant_inspect scope. Default: org users see tenant-level aggregates only. For private deployments allow obfuscating model/variant names (model_hash).

toni: Edgecases: multiple cache layers. Add optional cache_layers array or send combined cache_saved_tokens with provenance="combined" when layers not reported. Also include rollout_id when available to correlate routing changes.

ash: Perf calc quick: at 5k rps global, 0.5% sample -> ~2.16M events/day. If we increment counters at ingest rather than persist raw events, storage monthly is small. Keep raw traces for 100% routes and a tiny anomaly reservoir.

billing-bot: Recommendation: run sims for sample rates 0.1%, 0.5%, 1% and produce expected daily ingest + monthly cost. Also run daily reconciliation over 7-day window and alert if mismatch > 1%.

sam: Action items: (1) i'll open RFC with schema + aggregator pseudocode; (2) ash to wire aggregator second-moment math and validation job; (3) toni to design console row + CI microcopy; (4) billing to run ingest sims. I'll ping product & billing after RFC.
